items.title: Pocognoli to lean on Scotland's 'captain group of five'
items.description: Sebastien Pocognoli is delighted to welcome "exciting" Scott McTominay into his squad, saying the Napoli midfielder is one of the "fantastic leaders" that helped persuade him to become Scotland head coach.
